change: The nightly pushes and opens its pull requests as the Sustenaut nightly GitHub App (NIGHTLY_APP_ID, NIGHTLY_APP_KEY): one token per governed repository, for it alone, with contents, pull-requests and workflows write and actions read, from actions/create-github-app-token. A fine-grained token covers one owner only, and the governed repositories moved to the Sustenaut organization. Without the app it falls back to PUBKIT_BUMP_TOKEN with a warning
